definitions.explanation: Indicates something lasting indefinitely without change or reversal. More factual and formal than {永遠|えいえん}に, often used for official, legal, or scientific permanence.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This record will be preserved permanently.

examples.japanese: {永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no guarantee it will last forever.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、{永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: That species went extinct and disappeared from the Earth for good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

notes:
Adverbial form of ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧ (permanence; eternity) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Compared to ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, this word is more objective, factual, and formal. It is preferred in scientific, legal, and official contexts where genuine permanence is at stake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preserve permanently
- {永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{失|うしな}われる→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to be permanently lost
- {永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue perpetually
- {永久|えいきゅう}に⟦{凍結|とうけつ}→凍結：09613_touketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to freeze permanently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: forever; eternally — more emotional and literary, used for feelings, memories, and hyperbole
- ⟦{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}→恒久的：06265_koukyuuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: permanently — formal/official synonym, used in policy and institutional contexts
- {半永久的|はんえいきゅうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: semi-permanently — indicates very long but not truly infinite duration
